mapper.select: SELECT enrollments.id, enrollments.lecture_id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, courses.credits, enrollments.status, enrollments.total_score, enrollments.letter_grade FROM enrollments JOIN lectures ON enrollments.lecture_id = lectures.id JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN users ON lectures.professor_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id WHERE enrollments.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}) AND semesters.academic_year = #{year} AND semesters.term = IF(#{semester} = 1, 'FIRST', 'SECOND')

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(courses.credits), 0) FROM enrollments JOIN lectures ON enrollments.lecture_id = lectures.id JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id WHERE enrollments.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}) AND semesters.academic_year = #{year} AND semesters.term = IF(#{semester} = 1, 'FIRST', 'SECOND') AND enrollments.status != 'DROPPED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollments (student_id, lecture_id, status, enrolled_at) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}), #{lectureId}, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}) AND lecture_id = #{lectureId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE lecture_id = #{lectureId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT capacity FROM lectures WHERE id = #{lectureId}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.credits), 0) FROM enrollments e JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN courses c ON l.course_id = c.id WHERE e.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}) AND l.semester_id = (SELECT semester_id FROM lectures WHERE id = #{lectureId}) AND e.status != 'DROPPED'

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lecture_schedules new_ls JOIN lectures new_l ON new_ls.lecture_id = new_l.id JOIN lecture_schedules existing_ls ON new_ls.day_of_week = existing_ls.day_of_week JOIN lectures existing_l ON existing_ls.lecture_id = existing_l.id JOIN enrollments e ON existing_l.id = e.lecture_id WHERE new_l.id = #{lectureId} AND e.student_id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}) AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND new_l.semester_id = existing_l.semester_id AND new_ls.start_period <= existing_ls.end_period AND new_ls.end_period >= existing_ls.start_period )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment_histories (student_id, lecture_id, action, created_at) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM students WHERE user_id = #{studentId}), #{lectureId}, #{action}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
